column1: # Roadmap M3.10: the five landscape samples against their terrain copies, measured 2026-11-20 with ./gradlew :engine-desktop:perfBaseline -PperfScenes=... -PperfRuns=1 (one run per scene, so a first look, not a baseline; same machine as docs/performance/baseline-windows.tsv). The terrain copies also start Jolt physics and play the Action RPG follow camera, which the originals do not
# Forgeroom performance baseline (roadmap M9.5); medians of 1 run(s) per scene, 330 frames each, the first 30 not measured
# Machine: Windows 11 10.0 amd64, 8 processors; Java 21.0.11; the GPU is in each row
# Frame times wait for the GPU to finish (glFinish), so vsync does not hide them; heap is the Java heap only, not native memory
